levels.surface: الحاكم أبو علي الحسين بن أحمدالبيهقي

notes: the chain ends at Ibrahim b. Abbas, who reports being «بين يدي» al-Rida: the Imam speaks and acts in the scene, so no Imam link is written (rules 6 and 11)
the matn holds a second isnad («ولقد حدثني أبي، عن أبيه ...») carrying the Imam's own words: a second saying with its own isnad (rule 11)
the dream account and «فقال لي ابن ذكوان» are in scene; «أحمدالبيهقي» is written without a space in the text
